name: Podio
one_liner: Podio offers a RESTful API with OAuth2 authentication, SDKs, webhooks, and an official MCP server for AI integration.
auth_notes: OAuth2 is used for authentication and authorization.
access_notes: API keys can be generated from the Podio account settings without additional cost.

extras.rate_limits: 250 calls per hour for Limit A and 1,000 calls per hour for Limit B (base limits)

evidence.snippet: The Podio API uses the OAuth2 protocol for authentication.
Get started right away - generate your API key.
It is RESTful and uses json as the exchange format.
The Podio MCP (Model Context Protocol) Server connects AI assistants — ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Claude Desktop, and any other MCP-compatible platform — directly to your Podio data.
